data.name: Lujainah
data.gender_notes: Lujainah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A radiant moonlight that shines on the face of the earth with grace and beauty. The name Lujainah carries the meaning “Graceful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Lujainah usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the inner radiance and grace that shines from within, reflecting the light of God in the world
data.etymology: Lujainah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lujainah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: لُجَيْنَة
in_arabic.long_meaning: لُجَيْنَة هي اسم علم مؤنث مشتق من الجذر العربي لجن، والذي يعني الجمال والأنوثة واللطافة، وقد ورد هذا الاسم في العديد من النصوص الإسلامية والتراثية العربية، ويعتبر من الأسماء المهمة في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: لُجینہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: لُجینہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو لجن سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورتی اور عورتوں کی لطافت، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم ثقافت میں بہت اہم ہے اور اسلامی روایت میں اسے بہت значیت دی جاتی ہے

in_hindi.name: लुजैना

data.cultural_impact: The name Lujainah holds significant cultural importance for many Muslims, as it invokes the image of a peaceful, illuminated night, filled with devotion and tranquility. It echoes the beauty of nature and the nights of spiritual growth during the Islamic holy month of Ramadan.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Lujainah symbolizes the eternal light of Allah, guiding us through life's darkest hours. It serves as a reminder of the importance of inner enlightenment and striving to illuminate our hearts with the light of God's wisdom and guidance. The name Lujainah can also be seen as a reflection of the Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him) saying, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'The likeness of Anthony (al-Mumpyas), one of the monks, is that of a container filled with du'a and light.'", encouraging individuals to fill their lives with constant supplications to Allah, illuminating their journey toward Him.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Graceful" symbolizes A radiant moonlight that shines on the face of the earth with grace and beauty. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Lujainah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of graceful.
